# 介紹│Introduce
將金蘋果放在中央，並以下界之星包圍，即可合成附魔金蘋果。這就像是將下界之星的魔力賦予給金蘋果一般。此配方讓附魔金蘋果仍然保持稀有，但也能實現大量生產。│Place the golden apple in the center and surround it with nether stars to craft the enchanted golden apple. This is like imbuing the magic power of the nether star into the golden apple. This recipe keeps the enchanted golden apple rare but allows for mass production.

**※你可以在「Gallery」中查看具體的合成配方**│**※You can check the specific crafting recipe in "Gallery"**
